mcq_fix.why: option 1 had odd 'Brihatpalayanas/Pallavas'; standard G2 2008 order

mcq_drop.why: obscure trivia (north Andhra 'in his 37th year') beyond PYQ depth

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: capital shift Amarapuri to Denduluru is by Madhava Varma II (option 2), not Vikramendravarma; stray 'III' in stem

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact ruler identification: who shifted capital Amarapuri to Denduluru (Madhava Varma II), title Janasraya (MV II).
Dynastic order questions (Ikshvakus -> Brihatpalayanas -> Salankayanas -> Vishnukundins) recur in G2.
Traps: founder is Indravarma (not Govinda Varma); Salankayanas = Vaishnavism; Indrapalanagara = Tummalagudem, Telangana.
App has many long multi-statement inscription/title items with source-dependent attributions; PYQ depth is lighter.
